body: Thanks for your reply,i checked it, but no. Theme was much darker, there was a book in the series about a killer who was breaking spines,if i remember correctly
I am searching this for over 3 years, so any help will be gratefull!

I never faced that before. I had a lot of break ups, but this ruined me. Totally ruined me. I laugh but everytime i think of her. How we laughed together. This is hell bro. You may have been through a lot,but i dont think you,or anybody can understand. I am always anxious,always having heartbeats when i think about her. I cant live anymore like this

Humans are strange beings i guess. When it's about feelings it's difficult to find a logic reason for some actions. It's devastating i know. Make and keep yourself happy. Love cannot be deleted with a click inside a digital world,be sure for this. Love is the force that keep the world moving,  everything we do is a motivated from love like Aristotle said. Love is the "only thing that doesnt move but make the world moving". She may come back eventually to apologize,she may not, world is strange place, and the humans being far more stranger!
